title: Where Do You Start When Home Is Gone? Shelter and Everyday Essentials After Nepal’s Floods
excerpt: Imagine leaving home with only the clothes you are wearing. You find a safe place to sleep. Then morning comes. You need clean clothes, soap, water, and somewhere to care for your children. For families affected by Nepal’s floods, shelter is about more than one night. Nepal shelter aid can help them get through the first days with safety and dignity. What Does Emergency Shelter Include?
